output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid reacting only because the moment feels urgent.
output_fields.avoidance_note_hi: केवल क्षण की तीव्रता के कारण प्रतिक्रिया देने से बचें।
output_fields.source_basis: Derived from approved Word of the Day theme bank.

historical_selection.dependency_note: D04 reads the D02 reflection theme after no weekday match. Its approved-bank wording describes legacy preview status, not AG70D source/publication approval.

editorial_review.english_hindi_consistency: Both versions advise reflection before action; the Hindi urgency phrase is interpretive rather than literal and needs bilingual editorial review.
safety_notes: A reflective suggestion must not discourage genuinely time-critical action.
No therapeutic, astronomical or traditional authority is established.
Any future theme linkage must use eligible AG70D output, never legacy preview approval.
editorial_review.rewrite_scope: Review optional and non-universal framing and correct legacy approval provenance in a future publication candidate; do not change the source template.

output_fields.guidance_text_en: Keep the day simple: observe, decide slowly, and act with steadiness.
output_fields.guidance_text_hi: दिन को सरल रखें: देखें, धीरे निर्णय लें और स्थिरता से कार्य करें।
output_fields.recommended_action_en: Choose one meaningful task and complete it without distraction.
output_fields.recommended_action_hi: एक सार्थक कार्य चुनें और उसे बिना विचलन पूरा करें।
output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid scattering attention across too many concerns.
output_fields.avoidance_note_hi: ध्यान को बहुत अधिक चिंताओं में बिखेरने से बचें।
output_fields.source_basis: Neutral editorial fallback; not astrological prediction.

historical_selection.dependency_note: Chosen after no weekday or word-theme match; no Thursday, balance or awareness-based traditional rule is established by the preview.

editorial_review.english_hindi_consistency: The title, guidance, single-task suggestion and avoidance note are broadly aligned; fluency and accessibility still require bilingual review.
safety_notes: Decide slowly is not appropriate as a universal instruction for urgent situations.
Title must not promise the actual quality of a reader's day.
An empty or unapproved bank must withhold output, not silently select this research fallback.
editorial_review.rewrite_scope: Review optional framing and avoid universal slow-decision or successful-day implications in a separately authorized publication candidate.
